title: braze: an open-source agentic coding harness where every reliability lever is an independently switchable benchmark ablation
description: Rust workspace (15 crates) implementing an agentic coding-CLI harness and its benchmark runner (braze-bench). Built as research infrastructure for the study "Not All Scaffolding Helps: A Lever-by-Lever Study of Agentic Harnesses at Small-Model Scales": every reliability lever (lead model, planner, tool deferral, textual rescue, observation collapse, post-edit check, task list) toggles per benchmark row via +ablate: suffixes, and every sweep JSON embeds the harness git commit, suite fingerprint, per-model digests, and Ollama server version. This deposit archives the code and the raw sweep JSON files cited by the manuscript.
